info.title: WIS WhatsApp API
info.description: Local SQLite API for one WIS connection wis-5679. Bearer tokens have explicit scopes. Admin cookies and same-origin Origin are required for administration. Sends and webhook delivery are disabled by default. Live dashboard pagination preserves data arrays and adds top-level meta. Snapshots are observed data, never a claim of complete WhatsApp history. Sync queues read-only work and does not activate outbound. Successful read audits are sampled once per actor/resource/minute and contain no query, content, credentials or QR.

post.description: Own-account catalog, collections and blocklist take no target. Community/group/newsletter/contact_profile require a known matching JID. Unknown targets, URLs and unexpected targets are rejected before queueing. Commands are reads only. History requires an existing conversation JID and oldest usable persisted message anchor. Exactly 50 messages are requested; count and other extra properties are rejected. A done read-command means request accepted, not history received or complete. Only a correlated receipt marks the request arrived. Avatar reads require known contact/group or verified own-account JID; accept kind/target only, never an arbitrary remote URL. No automatic avatar refresh is scheduled. group_requests and community_subgroups accept only kind/target and require administrator cookie. Subgroups require observed community evidence. No join, accept, reject, invite or membership change is available. account_limits accepts only kind, with no target or extra properties; reads own account limits without changing any sending gate. newsletter_messages accepts only kind/target for an already observed channel; administrator-only fixed 50-message read. No subscribe or receipt operation. bot_list accepts only kind, with no target or extra fields. Administrator manual read of provider catalog only. contact_catalog accepts only kind/target with exact known contact PN JID; administrator manual read only, no LID inference or arbitrary owner URL.

get.summary: Read persisted blocklist; administrator cookie only
get.description: Administrator-only persisted blocklist. A failed refresh preserves earlier rows: stale marks retained information, last_success_at dates its last successful read, last_attempt_at dates the latest attempt, and error is a sanitized code. Retained rows do not prove current blocking state. GET performs no provider request or account mutation.

get.summary: Actual local event inventory, delivery signature/retry contract and distinct WHAPI reference categories
get.description: webhooks:write scope. Only message.created, message.updated, operation.updated are emitted by local triggers. WHAPI reference categories are not wire-compatible event names. No action is activated by reading this endpoint. Retry contract: max_attempts=5 includes the initial attempt; at most four retries are scheduled after 2, 4, 8 and 16 seconds. A failed fifth attempt is terminal; its available_at value does not schedule another retry.

get.summary: Read cached avatar metadata or authenticated private image for a known JID
get.description: Metadata allowlists safe fields only: target,observed,available,cached,stale,status,mime,size,updated_at,last_attempt_at,error,content_url. No provider URL or filename is exposed. cached requires an existing file within private avatars storage. Own account requires administrator and verified identity. Content requires a registered UUID filename, realpath containment, JPEG/PNG/WebP MIME and magic validation, maximum2MiB, no-store headers.

get.summary: Read persisted explicit LID/PN mappings and unknown identifiers
get.description: Read scope only, no network or auth-state reads. Explicit identity snapshots require canonical LID and PN plus recognized source lid-mapping.update, messaging-history.set or contacts. Contact identifiers without explicit mapping have status unknown; a LID never generates a phone number. Conflicts preserve original observed PN and flag conflicting_pn. GET never merges contacts or modifies consent. candidate_pns contains at most20 validated distinct PN JIDs, including preserved and contradictory candidates. Exact PN and free-text filters include these candidates. Shared candidates propagate conflict visibility across affected rows without writing the database.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Canonical row JID returns one detail

200.description: data row(s): id,lid,pn,phone_e164,status observed|conflict|unknown,conflict,conflicting_pn,source,observed_at,updated_at,contact_ids. List meta total,limit,offset,has_more,history_complete=false,source=persisted_identity_observations, candidate_pns validated PN JID array (maximum20)

get.summary: Read observed WhatsApp statuses that remain unexpired and unrevoked
get.description: Read scope. SQL expiry/revocation filters run before list pagination, counts and detail selection, independently of worker cleanup. Generic snapshots does not allow story kind. Empty results do not prove no WhatsApp statuses. No media downloads, provider URLs, keys, read receipts or publishing. Content can expire after response; clients should hide it at expires_at and discard expired cached views.

get.summary: Read cached group-requests without remote mutations
get.description: Read scope. Known target required; community-subgroups additionally requires community snapshot or observed isCommunity=true. Explicit allowlist strips invite codes/links/secrets. No remote query on GET. Bounded at2000 entries. Empty not_collected differs from verified complete empty; stale unavailable snapshots remain labeled. observed_events are separate passive group.join-request evidence, bounded200 rows with history20 each; they never establish the current pending-request list. observed_events_meta includes total,limit,truncated,complete=false,current_pending_inferred=false. IQ requests and availability remain separate even on provider500.

get.summary: Local observed messages from a known newsletter
get.description: Read scope. Returns data array of id, server_id, date, type, body and media_available:false. No URLs, keys, downloads, sends, subscription or read receipts. Metadata reports observed/available/response_verified/stale/error and last attempt/success; history_complete is always false. At most 50 provider messages retained for this observation; local q/limit/offset paginate only this snapshot.

get.summary: Observed nested products of an exact stored collection
get.description: No inferred product joins. Returns safe nested data array and pagination metadata, products_collected/products_truncated. Missing collection members are not a verified empty list. Owner-scoped summary preserves unavailable state. Never loads media.

get.summary: Observed provider bot catalog, not WIS automations or contacts
get.description: Read scope. Local snapshot only. Returns jid/persona_id only, partial:true and history_complete:false. Metadata preserves failed refresh with stale entries and sanitized errors/timestamps. Does not create chats, contact records or subscriptions.

get.summary: Persisted catalog for an exact known PN contact
get.description: Read scope. Requires exact contacts.wa_jid or phone_e164; never resolves LID mappings. Products are isolated by owner_jid and safely projected. Owner summary carries stale/error/timestamps; unknown is not verified empty. No remote query from GET, no sends or purchases.
